It creates the demo Admin and Editor, with emails matching the test fixture and passwords from `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`. It also creates a Trip, Recaps in each status (Draft, Submitted, Published), and one Draft and one Published Page, so a grader can try every capability straight away.\n\n**`cms backup`.** A new CLI subcommand. It takes an online-backup copy of the SQLite database and the uploads folder, and zips them with the standard library into `cms-backup-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.zip` in an output folder given as an argument. It refuses any output folder inside the repository. Backup archives are also gitignored as a second safeguard.\n\n**Final route audit.** A sweep confirms that every console route redirects anonymous visitors to login, and that the table-driven Editor test covers every Admin-only route and action listed in the spec.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The seed script on a fresh database creates the Admin, the Editor, a Trip, at least one Recap in each status, a Draft Page and a Published Page, and exits 0.\n- [ ] The seed script exits non-zero with a clear message when either password variable is missing. No password is hard-coded.\n- [ ] Running `cms publish` after seeding produces a site with the Published content only.\n- [ ] `main([\"backup\", <folder>])` writes one dated archive containing the database and the uploaded Images.\n- [ ] `cms backup` with an output folder inside the repository is refused with a non-zero exit, and no archive is written.\n- [ ] `.gitignore` excludes backup archives.\n- [ ] A test requests every console route anonymously and gets a redirect to login for each one.\n- [ ] The Editor table covers Trip writes, all Page routes, all Account routes, Publish, Unpublish, Send back, and edit, Submit and delete on a Recap the Editor doesn't Own.\n- [ ] The full test suite passes, including `tests/test_t00.py`.\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- #2 (T01)\n- #3 (T02)\n- #4 (T03)\n- #5 (T04)\n- #6 (T05)\n- #7 (T06)\n- #8 (T07)\n- #9 (T08)\n\n-----\nroutes/\nstatic/\n__init__.py  216B\naccounts.py  4.2K\ncli.py  5.7K\ndashboard.py  1.4K\ndb.py  4.3K\nflash.py  502B\nimages.py  4.9K\nmain.py  2.7K\nmarkdown.py  4.1K\npages.py  4.2K\npolicy.py  1.9K\npublish.py  6.3K\nrecaps.py  6.3K\nsecurity.py  2.3K\nseed.py  3.1K\nsettings.py  1.3K\nsite_state.py  2.8K\nslugs.py  1.1K\ntemplating.py  422B\ntrips.py  2.9K\nconftest.py  2.3K\ntest_admin_denied.py  3.4K\ntest_admin_style.py  2.8K\ntest_ctx_guard.py  3.2K\ntest_t00.py  949B\ntest_t01.py  7.7K\ntest_t02.py  15.4K\ntest_t03.py  20.3K\ntest_t04.py  15.7K\ntest_t05.py  10.7K\ntest_t06.py  24.7K\ntest_t07.py  21.8K\ntest_t08.py  17.4K\ntest_t09.py  18.9K\ntest_usage_report.py  2.6K\n... The database path is read from settings on every call.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    class_year    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    conference TEXT NOT NULL,\n    city       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    end_date   TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recap (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    trip_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trip (id),\n    owner_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title             TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_class_year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                      CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    published_at      TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    owner_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title        TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body         TEXT NOT NULL,\n    nav_position INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS image (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    recap_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recap (id),\n    filename     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    content_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size         INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    alt          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_state (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),\n    last_rendered_at  TEXT,\n    content_changed_at TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection; commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    except BaseException:\n        conn.rollback()\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _add_column_if_missing(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str,\n                           definition: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never alters a table that already exists, so\n    a column added to SCHEMA later is added here for databases made before it.\"\"\"\n    existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    if column not in existing:\n        try:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:\n            # Another process started at the same moment and added it first.\n            if \"duplicate column name\" not in str(exc):\n                raise\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"recap\", \"published_at\", \"TEXT\")\n        # A development database created while this column had another name\n        # (last_published_at) may still have the old column; it is left alone.\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"site_state\", \"last_rendered_at\", \"TEXT\")\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"site_state\", \"content_changed_at\", \"TEXT\")\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. {"parentUuid":"70e696c3-9e80-4675-8527-d73506dcee32","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92aded0b-0647-404f-883e-af032b6854c9","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015yrMwxR6sULit9bA6TfEs6","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Accounts: creation, lookup and password checks.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Verified against when an email is unknown, so both failures cost the same.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Account:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    name: str\n    class_year: int\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_row(cls, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Account:\n        return cls(row[\"id\"], row[\"email\"], row[\"name\"], row[\"class_year\"],\n                   row[\"role\"], bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef create_account(email: str, name: str, class_year: int, role: str,\n                   password: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Insert an Account; return its id, or None if the email is taken.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n            \"password_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email.strip().lower(), name, class_year, role,\n             hash_password(password)),\n        )\n        return cur.lastrowid if cur.rowcount else None\n\n\nclass UnknownAccount(LookupError):\n    \"\"\"No Account has this id.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LastActiveAdmin(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The change would leave the club without an active Admin.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef list_accounts() -> list[Account]:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account ORDER BY active DESC, \"\n                            \"role, name\").fetchall()\n    return [Account.from_row(r) for r in rows]\n\n\ndef _lock_account(conn, account_id: int):\n    \"\"\"Start a write transaction and return the Account's row.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (account_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise UnknownAccount(account_id)\n    return row\n\n\ndef _is_last_active_admin(conn, row) -> bool:\n    if not (row[\"role\"] == \"admin\" and row[\"active\"]):\n        return False\n    return conn.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE role = 'admin' \"\n                        \"AND active = 1\").fetchone()[0] <= 1\n\n\ndef set_role(account_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change an Account's role; refuse to demote the last active Admin.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = _lock_account(conn, account_id)\n        if role != \"admin\" and _is_last_active_admin(conn, row):\n            raise LastActiveAdmin(account_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE account SET role = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (role, account_id))\n\n\ndef deactivate(account_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Deactivate an Account; refuse for the last active Admin. Irreversible.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = _lock_account(conn, account_id)\n        if _is_last_active_admin(conn, row):\n            raise LastActiveAdmin(account_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE account SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (account_id,))\n\n\ndef set_password(account_id: int, password: str) -> None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        _lock_account(conn, account_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE account SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (hash_password(password), account_id))\n\n\ndef get(account_id: int) -> Account | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (account_id,)).fetchone()\n    return Account.from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(email: str, password: str) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the active Account for these credentials, else None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account WHERE email = ?\",\n                           (email.strip().lower(),)).fetchone()\n    stored = row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH\n    try:\n        ok = _hasher.verify(stored, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        ok = False\n    if row and ok and row[\"active\"]:\n        return Account.from_row(row)\n    return None\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\nPERMISSION_DETAIL = \"You do not have permission to do that\"\n\n\nclass PermissionDenied(HTTPException):\n    \"\"\"The Account is signed in but the policy says no. Distinct from the CSRF\n    refusal, which is also a 403: a browser is shown a page for this one.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(403, PERMISSION_DETAIL)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise PermissionDenied()\n        return account\n\n    return guard\n441:    for path, item in app.openapi()[\"paths\"].items():\n442-        if not path.startswith(prefix):\n443-            continue\n444-        concrete = {"parentUuid":"50b146a6-27f5-4213-a20d-e8090ed07a81","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92aded0b-0647-404f-883e-af032b6854c9","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01W31jxu74cEYYLcuvjdfDrG","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin, with /login and /logout beside it; the\npublic site answers at /. Add routes in their own modules under app/routes/ and\ninclude them here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.exception_handlers import http_exception_handler\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, recaps, trips\nfrom app.security import PermissionDenied, csrf_protect, current_account\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT:\n        log.warning(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY is not set: sessions are signed with the \"\n                    \"public development key. Development use only.\")\n    db.init_db()\n    # csrf_protect runs on every route, so no state-changing route can skip it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", dependencies=[Depends(csrf_protect)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\",\n                       https_only=False)\n\n    # Only app/static/ is served; never the repo root, uploads or site/.\n    app.mount(\"/static\", StaticFiles(directory=Path(__file__).parent / \"static\"),\n              name=\"static\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionDenied)\n    async def permission_denied(request: Request, exc: PermissionDenied):\n        \"\"\"A browser gets a styled page with a way back; anything else keeps\n        the JSON body.\"\"\"\n        account = current_account(request)\n        if \"text/html\" not in request.headers.get(\"accept\", \"\") or account is None:\n            return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/denied.html\", {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"account\": account},\n            status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(trips.router)\n    app.include_router(recaps.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"items\": [], \"css_path\": \"style.css\", \"home_path\": \"index.html\",\n             \"instagram_url\": settings.INSTAGRAM_URL},\n        )\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"ebe0e452-fc28-4686-b0ea-f6529315b052","timestamp":"2026-10-24T21:27:10.508Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin, with /login and /logout beside it; For setup, install, or connection problems, read install.md.\\n\\n## Usage\\n\\n```bash\\nbrowser-harness -c '\\nnew_tab(\\\"https://docs.browser-use.com\\\")\\nwait_for_load()\\nprint(page_info())\\n'\\n```\\n\\n- Invoke as browser-harness — it's on $PATH. No cd, no uv run.\\n- First navigation is new_tab(url), not goto_url(url) — goto runs in the user's active tab and clobbers their work.\\n\\nAvailable interaction skills:\\n- interaction-skills/connection.md — startup sequence, tab visibility, omnibox popup fix\\n\\nAvailable domain skills:\\n- tiktok/upload.md\\n- polymarket/scraping.md\\n\\n## Tool call shape\\n\\n```bash\\nbrowser-harness -c '\\n# any python. helpers pre-imported. daemon auto-starts.\\n'\\n```\\n\\nrun.py calls ensure_daemon() before exec — you never start/stop manually unless you want to.\\n\\n### Remote browsers\\n\\nUse remote for parallel sub-agents (each gets its own isolated browser via a distinct BU_NAME) or on a headless server. BROWSER_USE_API_KEY must be set. start_remote_daemon, list_cloud_profiles, list_local_profiles, sync_local_profile are pre-imported.\\n\\n```bash\\nbrowser-harness -c '\\nstart_remote_daemon(\\\"work\\\")                               # default — clean browser, no profile\\n# start_remote_daemon(\\\"work\\\", profileName=\\\"my-work\\\")      # reuse a cloud profile (already logged in)\\n# start_remote_daemon(\\\"work\\\", profileId=\\\"<uuid>\\\")         # same, but by UUID\\n# start_remote_daemon(\\\"work\\\", proxyCountryCode=\\\"de\\\", timeout=120)   # DE proxy, 2-hour timeout\\n# start_remote_daemon(\\\"work\\\", proxyCountryCode=None)      # disable the Browser Use proxy\\n'\\n\\nBU_NAME=work browser-harness -c '\\nnew_tab(\\\"https://example.com\\\")\\nprint(page_info())\\n'\\n```\\n\\nstart_remote_daemon prints liveUrl and auto-opens it in the local browser (if a GUI is detected) so the user can watch along. Headless servers print only — share the URL with the user. The daemon PATCHes the cloud browser to stop on shutdown, which persists profile state. Running remote daemons bill until timeout.\\n\\nProfiles (cookies-only login state) live in interaction-skills/profile-sync.md — covers list_cloud_profiles(), the chat-driven \\\"which profile?\\\" pattern, and sync_local_profile() for uploading a local Chrome profile.\\n\\n## Search first\\n\\nSearch `agent-workspace/domain-skills/` first for the domain you are working on before inventing a new approach.\\n\\nOnly if you start struggling with a specific mechanic while navigating, look in interaction-skills/ for helpers. The available interaction skills are:\\n- cookies.md\\n- cross-origin-iframes.md\\n- dialogs.md\\n- downloads.md\\n- drag-and-drop.md\\n- dropdowns.md\\n- iframes.md\\n- network-requests.md\\n- print-as-pdf.md\\n- profile-sync.md\\n- screenshots.md\\n- scrolling.md\\n- shadow-dom.md\\n- tabs.md\\n- uploads.md\\n- viewport.md\\n\\nUseful commands:\\n\\n```bash\\nrg --files agent-workspace/domain-skills\\nrg -n \\\"tiktok|upload\\\" agent-workspace/domain-skills\\n```\\n\\n## Always contribute back\\n\\nIf you learned anything non-obvious about how a site works, open a PR to `agent-workspace/domain-skills/<site>/` before you finish. Default to contributing. The harness gets better only because agents file what they learn. If figuring something out cost you a few steps, the next run should not pay the same tax.\\n\\nExamples of what's worth a PR:\\n\\n- A private API the page calls (XHR/fetch endpoint, request shape, auth) — often 10× faster than DOM scraping.\\n- A stable selector that beats the obvious one, or an obfuscated CSS-module class to avoid.\\n- A framework quirk — \\\"the dropdown is a React combobox that only commits on Escape\\\", \\\"this Vue list only renders rows inside its own scroll container, so scrollIntoView on the row doesn't work — you have to scroll the container\\\".\\n- A URL pattern — direct route, required query params (?lang=en, ?th=1), a variant that skips a loader.\\n- A wait that wait_for_load() misses, with the reason.\\n- A trap — stale drafts, legacy IDs that now return null, unicode quirks, beforeunload dialogs, CAPTCHA surfaces.\\n\\n### What a domain skill should capture\\n\\nThe *durable* shape of the site — the map, not the diary. Focus on what the next agent on this site needs to know before it starts:\\n\\n- URL patterns and query params.\\n- Private APIs and their payload shape.\\n- Stable selectors (data-*, aria-*, role, semantic classes).\\n- Site structure — containers, items per page, framework, where state lives.\\n- Framework/interaction quirks unique to this site.\\n- Waits and the reasons they're needed.\\n- Traps and the selectors that *don't* work.\\n\\n### Do not write\\n\\n- Raw pixel coordinates. They break on viewport, zoom, and layout changes. Describe how to *locate* the target (selector, scrollIntoView, aria-label, visible text) — never where it happened to be on your screen.\\n- Run narration or step-by-step of the specific task you just did.\\n- Secrets, cookies, session tokens, user-specific state. `agent-workspace/domain-skills/` is shared and public.\\n\\n## What actually works\\n\\n- Screenshots first: use capture_screenshot() to understand the current page quickly, find visible targets, and decide whether you need a click, a selector, or more navigation.\\n- Clicking: capture_screenshot() → read the pixel off the image → click_at_xy(x, y) → capture_screenshot() to verify. Suppress the Playwright-habit reflex of \\\"locate first, then click\\\" — no getBoundingClientRect, no selector hunt. Drop to DOM only when the target has no visible geometry (hidden input, 0×0 node). Hit-testing happens in Chrome's browser process, so clicks go through iframes / shadow DOM / cross-origin without extra work.\\n- Bulk HTTP: http_get(url) + ThreadPoolExecutor. No browser for static pages (249 Netflix pages in 2.8s).\\n- After goto: wait_for_load().\\n- Wrong/stale tab: ensure_real_tab(). Use it when the current tab is stale or internal; the daemon also auto-recovers from stale sessions on the next call.\\n- Verification: print(page_info()) is the simplest \\\"is this alive?\\\" check, but screenshots are the default way to verify whether a visible action actually worked.\\n- DOM reads: use js(...) for inspection and extraction when the screenshot shows that coordinates are the wrong tool.\\n- Iframe sites (Azure blades, Salesforce): click_at_xy(x, y) passes through; only drop to iframe DOM work when coordinate clicks are the wrong tool.\\n- Auth wall: redirected to login → stop and ask the user. Don't type credentials from screenshots.\\n- Raw CDP for anything helpers don't cover: cdp(\\\"Domain.method\\\", params).\\n\\n## Design constraints\\n\\n- Coordinate clicks default. Input.dispatchMouseEvent goes through iframes/shadow/cross-origin at the compositor level.\\n- Connect to the user's running Chrome. Don't launch your own browser.\\n- cdp-use is only for CDPClient.send_raw. Prefer raw CDP strings over typed wrappers.\\n- run.py stays tiny. No argparse, subcommands, or extra control layer.\\n- Core helpers stay short. Put task-specific helper additions in `agent-workspace/agent_helpers.py`; daemon/bootstrap and remote session admin live in the core package.\\n- Don't add a manager layer. No retries framework, session manager, daemon supervisor, config system, or logging framework.\\n\\n## Gotchas (field-tested)\\n\\n- Omnibox popups are fake page targets. Filter chrome://omnibox-popup... and other internals when you need a real tab.\\n- CDP target order != Chrome's visible tab-strip order. Use UI automation when the user means \\\"the first/second tab I can see\\\"; Target.activateTarget only shows a known target.\\n- Default daemon sessions can go stale. ensure_real_tab() re-attaches to a real page.\\n- Browser Use API is camelCase on the wire. cdpUrl, proxyCountryCode, etc.\\n- Remote cdpUrl is HTTPS, not ws. Resolve the websocket URL via /json/version.\\n- Stop cloud browsers with PATCH /browsers/{id} + {\\\"action\\\":\\\"stop\\\"}.\\n- After every meaningful action, re-screenshot before assuming it worked. Use the image to verify changed state, open menus, navigation, visible errors, and whether the page is in the state you expected.\\n- Use screenshots to drive exploration. They are often the fastest way to find the next click target, notice hidden blockers, and decide if a selector is even worth writing.\\n- Prefer compositor-level actions over framework hacks. Try screenshots, coordinate clicks, and raw key input before adding DOM-specific workarounds.\\n- If you need framework-specific DOM tricks, check interaction-skills/ first. That is where dropdown, dialog, iframe, shadow DOM, and form-specific guidance belongs.\\n\\n## Interaction notes\\n\\n- interaction-skills/ holds reusable UI mechanics such as dialogs, tabs, dropdowns, iframes, and uploads.\\n- `agent-workspace/domain-skills/` holds site-specific workflows and should be updated when you discover reusable patterns for a website.\\n\\nContents of /Users/andrewv/.claude/RTK.md (user's private global instructions for all projects):\\n\\n# Command output\\n\\nCommand output here is condensed to save tokens, keeping every signal and\\ndropping costly noise. {"parentUuid":"64c568c4-b8fa-4dd6-8987-de55258ba679","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMmiLpoVkmh3qina79he","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GRQrMozLmWpfUu5JPhyMVZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_traceability.py","content":"\"\"\"Direct tests for three acceptance criteria that were only covered indirectly.\n\n- #2 criterion 1: the Account schema has every listed field.\n- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside the permission-policy module.\n- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every admin-only or state-changing\n  console route, or the route is in the documented Editor-allowed list below.\n\"\"\"\nimport ast\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, policy\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, recaps, trips\nfrom tests.test_t01 import ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 1: the Account schema -----------------------------------\n\ndef test_account_schema_has_every_listed_field(database):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        columns = {r[\"name\"]: r for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(account)\")}\n        unique = [r[\"name\"] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA index_list(account)\")\n                  if r[\"unique\"]]\n        unique_cols = {c[\"name\"] for idx in unique\n                       for c in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA index_info({idx})\")}\n        seeded = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account\").fetchall()\n\n    for name in (\"email\", \"name\", \"class_year\", \"role\", \"password_hash\",\n                 \"active\", \"created_at\"):\n        assert name in columns, f\"account has no {name} column\"\n    assert \"email\" in unique_cols                       # email (unique)\n    assert seeded and all(r[\"password_hash\"].startswith(\"$argon2\") for r in seeded)\n    assert all(r[\"active\"] == 1 for r in seeded)        # an active flag\n    # the created timestamp is filled in on insert, as an ISO-8601 UTC time\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\dT\\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\dZ\", r[\"created_at\"])\n               for r in seeded)\n\n    # role is `admin` or `editor` and nothing else\n    with db.connect() as conn, pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n                     \"password_hash) VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 2027, \"\n                     \"'owner', 'h')\")\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------\n\nSQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\brole\\s*(=|!=|<>|\\bin\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as\n# (file, enclosing function). Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n}\n\n\ndef _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:\n    return any(\n        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n            and n.slice.value == \"role\")\n        for n in ast.walk(node))\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n}\n\n\ndef _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:\n    return any(\n        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n            and n.slice.value == \"role\")\n        for n in ast.walk(node))\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - set(hits)\n    assert not stale, stale\n\n\ndef test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check():\n    probe = ROOT / \"tests\" / \"_role_probe.py\"\n    try:\n        probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                         \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n        assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),\n                                                                   (\"<module>\", 3)]\n    finally:\n        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\n# ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------\n\n# Console routes an Editor may use, each on a Recap they Own while it is a\n# Draft. They change state, so they need an entry here or in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES;\n# the per-Recap refusals for other people's Recaps are tested in T03, T04, T06.\nEDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps\"): \"create a Recap Draft (#4 criterion 4)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/preview\"): \"Preview a Recap before its first save\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"): \"edit their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/delete\"): \"delete their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/submit\"): \"Submit their own Draft (#5 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/preview\"): \"Preview their own Draft\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\"): \"upload to their own Draft (#7 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\"):\n        \"delete an Image from their own Draft\",\n}\n\nROUTERS = (auth, console, accounts, trips, recaps, pages)\nSTATE_CHANGING = {\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\"}\n\n\ndef _action(route) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The policy action named by the route's `require(...)` guard.\"\"\"\n    actions = [cell.cell_contents\n               for dep in route.dependant.dependencies\n               for name, cell in zip(dep.call.__code__.co_freevars,\n                                     dep.call.__closure__ or ())\n               if name == \"action\"]\n    assert len(actions) == 1, (route.path, actions)\n    return actions[0]\n\n\ndef console_routes() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(method, path template, policy action) for every /admin route.\"\"\"\n    return sorted((method, route.path, _action(route))\n                  for router in ROUTERS for route in router.router.routes\n                  if route.path.startswith(\"/admin\")\n                  for method in route.methods)\n\n\ndef _template_for(method: str, concrete: str, templates) -> tuple[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"The route a concrete table row reaches. A literal segment beats a path\n    parameter, as it does when the app dispatches (preview before {page_id}).\"\"\"\n    matches = [(m, t) for m, t in templates if m == method\n               and re.fullmatch(re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"[^/]+\", t), concrete)]\n    return min(matches, key=lambda mt: mt[1].count(\"{\"), default=None)\n\n\ndef test_routers_seen_here_are_the_whole_console():\n    from tests.test_t09 import swept_routes\n    templates = {(m, re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"1\", re.sub(r\"\\{filename\\}\", \"x.png\", p)))\n                 for m, p, _ in console_routes()}\n    assert templates == set(swept_routes(create_app(), \"/admin\"))\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_only_or_state_changing_route_is_in_a_table():\n    routes = console_routes()\n    templates = [(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes]\n    in_editor_table = {_template_for(m, p.replace(\"{other}\", \"1\"), templates)\n                       for m, p in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES}\n    assert None not in in_editor_table, \"an ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES row matches no route\"\n\n    admin_only = {(m, p) for m, p, a in routes\n                  if policy.ROLE_RULES.get(a) == frozenset({policy.ADMIN})}\n    must_be_listed = admin_only | {(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes\n                                   if m in STATE_CHANGING}\n    missing = sorted(must_be_listed - in_editor_table - set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES))\n    assert not missing, missing\n\n    # every admin-only route is in the Editor table, never in the allowed list\n    assert admin_only <= in_editor_table\n    assert not admin_only & set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES)\n    assert set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES) <= set(templates), \"stale allowed entry\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"70288836-59c7-48da-a76f-790d79355523","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ac10d971-c94c-4656-a655-6f2183c6feb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

 probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                     \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n    assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in table covers every admin-only or state-changing\n  console route, or the route is in the documented Editor-allowed list below.\n\"\"\"\nimport ast\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, policy\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, recaps, trips\nfrom tests.test_t01 import ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 1: the Account schema -----------------------------------\n\ndef test_account_schema_has_every_listed_field(database):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        columns = {r[\"name\"]: r for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(account)\")}\n        unique = [r[\"name\"] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA index_list(account)\")\n                  if r[\"unique\"]]\n        unique_cols = {c[\"name\"] for idx in unique\n                       for c in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA index_info({idx})\")}\n        seeded = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account\").fetchall()\n\n    for name in (\"email\", \"name\", \"class_year\", \"role\", \"password_hash\",\n                 \"active\", \"created_at\"):\n        assert name in columns, f\"account has no {name} column\"\n    assert \"email\" in unique_cols                       # email (unique)\n    assert seeded and all(r[\"password_hash\"].startswith(\"$argon2\") for r in seeded)\n    assert all(r[\"active\"] == 1 for r in seeded)        # an active flag\n    # the created timestamp is filled in on insert, as an ISO-8601 UTC time\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\dT\\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\dZ\", r[\"created_at\"])\n               for r in seeded)\n\n    # role is `admin` or `editor` and nothing else\n    with db.connect() as conn, pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n                     \"password_hash) VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 2027, \"\n                     \"'owner', 'h')\")\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------\n\nSQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\brole\\s*(=|!=|<>|\\bin\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as\n# (file, enclosing function). Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n}\n\n\ndef _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:\n    return any(\n        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n            and n.slice.value == \"role\")\n        for n in ast.walk(node))\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - set(hits)\n    assert not stale, stale\n\n\ndef test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check():\n    probe = ROOT / \"tests\" / \"_role_probe.py\"\n    try:\n        probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                         \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n        assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),\n                                                                   (\"<module>\", 3)]\n    finally:\n        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\n# ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------\n\n# Console routes an Editor may use, each on a Recap they Own while it is a\n# Draft. They change state, so they need an entry here or in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES;\n# the per-Recap refusals for other people's Recaps are tested in T03, T04, T06.\nEDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps\"): \"create a Recap Draft (#4 criterion 4)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/preview\"): \"Preview a Recap before its first save\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"): \"edit their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/delete\"): \"delete their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/submit\"): \"Submit their own Draft (#5 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/preview\"): \"Preview their own Draft\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\"): \"upload to their own Draft (#7 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\"):\n        \"delete an Image from their own Draft\",\n}\n\nROUTERS = (auth, console, accounts, trips, recaps, pages)\nSTATE_CHANGING = {\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\"}\n\n\ndef _action(route) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The policy action named by the route's `require(...)` guard.\"\"\"\n    actions = [cell.cell_contents\n               for dep in route.dependant.dependencies\n               for name, cell in zip(dep.call.__code__.co_freevars,\n                                     dep.call.__closure__ or ())\n               if name == \"action\"]\n    assert len(actions) == 1, (route.path, actions)\n    return actions[0]\n\n\ndef console_routes() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(method, path template, policy action) for every /admin route.\"\"\"\n    return sorted((method, route.path, _action(route))\n                  for router in ROUTERS for route in router.router.routes\n                  if route.path.startswith(\"/admin\")\n                  for method in route.methods)\n\n\ndef _template_for(method: str, concrete: str, templates) -> tuple[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"The route a concrete table row reaches. A literal segment beats a path\n    parameter, as it does when the app dispatches (preview before {page_id}).\"\"\"\n    matches = [(m, t) for m, t in templates if m == method\n               and re.fullmatch(re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"[^/]+\", t), concrete)]\n    return min(matches, key=lambda mt: mt[1].count(\"{\"), default=None)\n\n\ndef test_routers_seen_here_are_the_whole_console():\n    from tests.test_t09 import swept_routes\n    templates = {(m, re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"1\", re.sub(r\"\\{filename\\}\", \"x.png\", p)))\n                 for m, p, _ in console_routes()}\n    assert templates == set(swept_routes(create_app(), \"/admin\"))\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_only_or_state_changing_route_is_in_a_table():\n    routes = console_routes()\n    templates = [(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes]\n    in_editor_table = {_template_for(m, p.replace(\"{other}\", \"1\"), templates)\n                       for m, p in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES}\n    assert None not in in_editor_table, \"an ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES row matches no route\"\n\n    admin_only = {(m, p) for m, p, a in routes\n                  if policy.ROLE_RULES.get(a) == frozenset({policy.ADMIN})}\n    must_be_listed = admin_only | {(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes\n                                   if m in STATE_CHANGING}\n    missing = sorted(must_be_listed - in_editor_table - set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES))\n    assert not missing, missing\n\n    # every admin-only route is in the Editor table, never in the allowed list\n    assert admin_only <= in_editor_table\n    assert not admin_only & set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES)\n    assert set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES) <= set(templates), \"stale allowed entry\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":118,"oldLines":15,"newStart":118,"newLines":12,"lines":["     assert not stale, stale"," "," ","-def test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check():","-    probe = ROOT / \"tests\" / \"_role_probe.py\"","-    try:","-        probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"","-                         \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")","-        assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),","-                                                                   (\"<module>\", 3)]","-    finally:","-        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)","+def test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check(tmp_path):","+    probe = tmp_path / \"probe.py\"","+    probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"","+                     \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")","+    assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),","+                                                               (\"<module>\", 3)]"," "," "," # ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"10a5880a-0700-47fa-ab6a-2b7c7184ca08","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ac10d971-c94c-4656-a655-6f2183c6feb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

re.compile(r\"\\b(WHERE|AND|OR|CHECK)\\s*\\(?\\s*role\\s*(=|!=|<>|IN\\b)\",\n                           re.IGNORECASE)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Direct tests for three acceptance criteria that were only covered indirectly.\n\n- #2 criterion 1: the Account schema has every listed field.\n- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside the permission-policy module.\n- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every admin-only or state-changing\n  console route, or the route is in the documented Editor-allowed list below.\n\"\"\"\nimport ast\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, policy\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, recaps, trips\nfrom tests.test_t01 import ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 1: the Account schema -----------------------------------\n\ndef test_account_schema_has_every_listed_field(database):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        columns = {r[\"name\"]: r for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(account)\")}\n        unique = [r[\"name\"] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA index_list(account)\")\n                  if r[\"unique\"]]\n        unique_cols = {c[\"name\"] for idx in unique\n                       for c in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA index_info({idx})\")}\n        seeded = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM account\").fetchall()\n\n    for name in (\"email\", \"name\", \"class_year\", \"role\", \"password_hash\",\n                 \"active\", \"created_at\"):\n        assert name in columns, f\"account has no {name} column\"\n    assert \"email\" in unique_cols                       # email (unique)\n    assert seeded and all(r[\"password_hash\"].startswith(\"$argon2\") for r in seeded)\n    assert all(r[\"active\"] == 1 for r in seeded)        # an active flag\n    # the created timestamp is filled in on insert, as an ISO-8601 UTC time\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\dT\\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\dZ\", r[\"created_at\"])\n               for r in seeded)\n\n    # role is `admin` or `editor` and nothing else\n    with db.connect() as conn, pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n                     \"password_hash) VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 2027, \"\n                     \"'owner', 'h')\")\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------\n\nSQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\brole\\s*(=|!=|<>|\\bin\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as\n# (file, enclosing function). Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n}\n\n\ndef _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:\n    return any(\n        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n            and n.slice.value == \"role\")\n        for n in ast.walk(node))\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - set(hits)\n    assert not stale, stale\n\n\ndef test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check(tmp_path):\n    probe = tmp_path / \"probe.py\"\n    probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                     \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n    assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),\n                                                               (\"<module>\", 3)]\n\n\n# ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------\n\n# Console routes an Editor may use, each on a Recap they Own while it is a\n# Draft. They change state, so they need an entry here or in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES;\n# the per-Recap refusals for other people's Recaps are tested in T03, T04, T06.\nEDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps\"): \"create a Recap Draft (#4 criterion 4)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/preview\"): \"Preview a Recap before its first save\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"): \"edit their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/delete\"): \"delete their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/submit\"): \"Submit their own Draft (#5 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/preview\"): \"Preview their own Draft\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\"): \"upload to their own Draft (#7 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\"):\n        \"delete an Image from their own Draft\",\n}\n\nROUTERS = (auth, console, accounts, trips, recaps, pages)\nSTATE_CHANGING = {\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\"}\n\n\ndef _action(route) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The policy action named by the route's `require(...)` guard.\"\"\"\n    actions = [cell.cell_contents\n               for dep in route.dependant.dependencies\n               for name, cell in zip(dep.call.__code__.co_freevars,\n                                     dep.call.__closure__ or ())\n               if name == \"action\"]\n    assert len(actions) == 1, (route.path, actions)\n    return actions[0]\n\n\ndef console_routes() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(method, path template, policy action) for every /admin route.\"\"\"\n    return sorted((method, route.path, _action(route))\n                  for router in ROUTERS for route in router.router.routes\n                  if route.path.startswith(\"/admin\")\n                  for method in route.methods)\n\n\ndef _template_for(method: str, concrete: str, templates) -> tuple[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"The route a concrete table row reaches. A literal segment beats a path\n    parameter, as it does when the app dispatches (preview before {page_id}).\"\"\"\n    matches = [(m, t) for m, t in templates if m == method\n               and re.fullmatch(re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"[^/]+\", t), concrete)]\n    return min(matches, key=lambda mt: mt[1].count(\"{\"), default=None)\n\n\ndef test_routers_seen_here_are_the_whole_console():\n    from tests.test_t09 import swept_routes\n    templates = {(m, re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"1\", re.sub(r\"\\{filename\\}\", \"x.png\", p)))\n                 for m, p, _ in console_routes()}\n    assert templates == set(swept_routes(create_app(), \"/admin\"))\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_only_or_state_changing_route_is_in_a_table():\n    routes = console_routes()\n    templates = [(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes]\n    in_editor_table = {_template_for(m, p.replace(\"{other}\", \"1\"), templates)\n                       for m, p in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES}\n    assert None not in in_editor_table, \"an ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES row matches no route\"\n\n    admin_only = {(m, p) for m, p, a in routes\n                  if policy.ROLE_RULES.get(a) == frozenset({policy.ADMIN})}\n    must_be_listed = admin_only | {(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes\n                                   if m in STATE_CHANGING}\n    missing = sorted(must_be_listed - in_editor_table - set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES))\n    assert not missing, missing\n\n    # every admin-only route is in the Editor table, never in the allowed list\n    assert admin_only <= in_editor_table\n    assert not admin_only & set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES)\n    assert set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES) <= set(templates), \"stale allowed entry\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":50,"oldLines":7,"newStart":50,"newLines":9,"lines":[" "," # ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------"," ","-SQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\brole\\s*(=|!=|<>|\\bin\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)","+# a test on the role column (not `SET role = ?`, which assigns it)","+SQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\b(WHERE|AND|OR|CHECK)\\s*\\(?\\s*role\\s*(=|!=|<>|IN\\b)\",","+                           re.IGNORECASE)"," "," # Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as"," # (file, enclosing function). \"email\" in unique_cols                       # email (unique)\n    assert seeded and all(r[\"password_hash\"].startswith(\"$argon2\") for r in seeded)\n    assert all(r[\"active\"] == 1 for r in seeded)        # an active flag\n    # the created timestamp is filled in on insert, as an ISO-8601 UTC time\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\dT\\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\dZ\", r[\"created_at\"])\n               for r in seeded)\n\n    # role is `admin` or `editor` and nothing else\n    with db.connect() as conn, pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n                     \"password_hash) VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 2027, \"\n                     \"'owner', 'h')\")\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------\n\n# a test on the role column (not `SET role = ?`, which assigns it)\nSQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\b(WHERE|AND|OR|CHECK)\\s*\\(?\\s*role\\s*(=|!=|<>|IN\\b)\",\n                           re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as\n# (file, enclosing function). Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n}\n\n\ndef _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:\n    return any(\n        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n            and n.slice.value == \"role\")\n        for n in ast.walk(node))\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - set(hits)\n    assert not stale, stale\n\n\ndef test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check(tmp_path):\n    probe = tmp_path / \"probe.py\"\n    probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                     \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n    assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),\n                                                               (\"<module>\", 3)]\n\n\n# ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------\n\n# Console routes an Editor may use, each on a Recap they Own while it is a\n# Draft. They change state, so they need an entry here or in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES;\n# the per-Recap refusals for other people's Recaps are tested in T03, T04, T06.\nEDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps\"): \"create a Recap Draft (#4 criterion 4)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/preview\"): \"Preview a Recap before its first save\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"): \"edit their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/delete\"): \"delete their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/submit\"): \"Submit their own Draft (#5 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/preview\"): \"Preview their own Draft\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\"): \"upload to their own Draft (#7 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\"):\n        \"delete an Image from their own Draft\",\n}\n\nROUTERS = (auth, console, accounts, trips, recaps, pages)\nSTATE_CHANGING = {\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\"}\n\n\ndef _action(route) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The policy action named by the route's `require(...)` guard.\"\"\"\n    actions = [cell.cell_contents\n               for dep in route.dependant.dependencies\n               for name, cell in zip(dep.call.__code__.co_freevars,\n                                     dep.call.__closure__ or ())\n               if name == \"action\"]\n    assert len(actions) == 1, (route.path, actions)\n    return actions[0]\n\n\ndef console_routes() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(method, path template, policy action) for every /admin route.\"\"\"\n    return sorted((method, route.path, _action(route))\n                  for router in ROUTERS for route in router.router.routes\n                  if route.path.startswith(\"/admin\")\n                  for method in route.methods)\n\n\ndef _template_for(method: str, concrete: str, templates) -> tuple[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"The route a concrete table row reaches. A literal segment beats a path\n    parameter, as it does when the app dispatches (preview before {page_id}).\"\"\"\n    matches = [(m, t) for m, t in templates if m == method\n               and re.fullmatch(re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"[^/]+\", t), concrete)]\n    return min(matches, key=lambda mt: mt[1].count(\"{\"), default=None)\n\n\ndef test_routers_seen_here_are_the_whole_console():\n    from tests.test_t09 import swept_routes\n    templates = {(m, re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"1\", re.sub(r\"\\{filename\\}\", \"x.png\", p)))\n                 for m, p, _ in console_routes()}\n    assert templates == set(swept_routes(create_app(), \"/admin\"))\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_only_or_state_changing_route_is_in_a_table():\n    routes = console_routes()\n    templates = [(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes]\n    in_editor_table = {_template_for(m, p.replace(\"{other}\", \"1\"), templates)\n                       for m, p in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES}\n    assert None not in in_editor_table, \"an ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES row matches no route\"\n\n    admin_only = {(m, p) for m, p, a in routes\n                  if policy.ROLE_RULES.get(a) == frozenset({policy.ADMIN})}\n    must_be_listed = admin_only | {(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes\n                                   if m in STATE_CHANGING}\n    missing = sorted(must_be_listed - in_editor_table - set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES))\n    assert not missing, missing\n\n    # every admin-only route is in the Editor table, never in the allowed list\n    assert admin_only <= in_editor_table\n    assert not admin_only & set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES)\n    assert set(EDITOR_ALLOWED_ROUTES) <= set(templates), \"stale allowed entry\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":71,"oldLines":15,"newStart":71,"newLines":18,"lines":[" }"," "," ","-def _mentions_role(node: ast.AST) -> bool:","-    return any(","-        (isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")","-        or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")","-        or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)","-            and n.slice.value == \"role\")","-        for n in ast.walk(node))","+def _is_role(n: ast.AST) -> bool:","+    \"\"\"`x.role`, `role` or `x[\"role\"]`: an operand that is itself a role.\"\"\"","+    return ((isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")","+            or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")","+            or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)","+                and n.slice.value == \"role\"))"," "," ","+def _compares_a_role(node: ast.Compare) -> bool:","+    return any(_is_role(n) for n in [node.left, *node.comparators])","+","+"," def role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:","     \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that","     involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ff8431cc-eb08-4792-88fe-4e19c0e9e093","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ac10d971-c94c-4656-a655-6f2183c6feb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

role is `admin` or `editor` and nothing else\n    with db.connect() as conn, pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO account (email, name, class_year, role, \"\n                     \"password_hash) VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 2027, \"\n                     \"'owner', 'h')\")\n\n\n# ---- #2 criterion 8: no ad-hoc role checks outside app/policy.py ----------\n\n# a test on the role column (not `SET role = ?`, which assigns it)\nSQL_ROLE_TEST = re.compile(r\"\\b(WHERE|AND|OR|CHECK)\\s*\\(?\\s*role\\s*(=|!=|<>|IN\\b)\",\n                           re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Role comparisons outside the policy that are not permission checks, as\n# (file, enclosing function). Each one is about the Account being changed or a\n# submitted value, never about what the signed-in Account may do.\nROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"app/db.py\", \"<module>\"):\n        \"the CHECK constraint on account.role: the schema's set of valid roles\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"_is_last_active_admin\"):\n        \"the last-active-Admin rule (#3 criterion 5), about the target Account\",\n    (\"app/accounts.py\", \"set_role\"):\n        \"is the new role a demotion; feeds the last-active-Admin rule\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"create_account\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form field against the known roles\",\n    (\"app/routes/accounts.py\", \"change_role\"):\n        \"validates the submitted role form ast.Attribute) and n.attr == \"role\")\n            or (isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == \"role\")\n            or (isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant)\n                and n.slice.value == \"role\"))\n\n\ndef _compares_a_role(node: ast.Compare) -> bool:\n    return any(_is_role(n) for n in [node.left, *node.comparators])\n\n\ndef role_comparisons(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(enclosing function, line, source) for each Python comparison that\n    involves a role, and each SQL string that compares the role column.\"\"\"\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())\n    source = path.read_text().splitlines()\n    found = []\n\n    def visit(node, func):\n        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):\n            inner = (child.name if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef,\n                                                      ast.AsyncFunctionDef))\n                     else func)\n            if isinstance(child, ast.Compare) and _mentions_role(child):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            elif (isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)\n                  and SQL_ROLE_TEST.search(child.value)):\n                found.append((func, child.lineno, source[child.lineno - 1].strip()))\n            visit(child, inner)\n\n    visit(tree, \"<module>\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_no_role_comparison_outside_the_policy_module():\n    hits = {}\n    for path in sorted((ROOT / \"app\").rglob(\"*.py\")):\n        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()\n        if rel == \"app/policy.py\":\n            continue\n        for func, line, text in role_comparisons(path):\n            hits.setdefault((rel, func), []).append(f\"{rel}:{line} {text}\")\n\n    ad_hoc = [h for key, lines in hits.items()\n              if key not in ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED for h in lines]\n    assert not ad_hoc, \"role checks outside app/policy.py:\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(ad_hoc)\n    # an allowlist entry that no longer matches anything is removed, not kept\n    stale = set(ROLE_COMPARISONS_ALLOWED) - set(hits)\n    assert not stale, stale\n\n\ndef test_the_role_scan_sees_a_role_check(tmp_path):\n    probe = tmp_path / \"probe.py\"\n    probe.write_text(\"def f(account):\\n    return account.role == 'admin'\\n\"\n                     \"Q = \\\"SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE role = 'admin'\\\"\\n\")\n    assert [(f, n) for f, n, _ in role_comparisons(probe)] == [(\"f\", 2),\n                                                               (\"<module>\", 3)]\n\n\n# ---- #10 criterion 8: the Editor table covers every console route --------\n\n# Console routes an Editor may use, each on a Recap they Own while it is a\n# Draft. str] = {\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps\"): \"create a Recap Draft (#4 criterion 4)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/preview\"): \"Preview a Recap before its first save\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"): \"edit their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/delete\"): \"delete their own Draft (#4 criterion 10)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/submit\"): \"Submit their own Draft (#5 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/preview\"): \"Preview their own Draft\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\"): \"upload to their own Draft (#7 criterion 1)\",\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\"):\n        \"delete an Image from their own Draft\",\n}\n\nROUTERS = (auth, console, accounts, trips, recaps, pages)\nSTATE_CHANGING = {\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\"}\n\n\ndef _action(route) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The policy action named zip(dep.call.__code__.co_freevars,\n                                     dep.call.__closure__ or ())\n               if name == \"action\"]\n    assert len(actions) == 1, (route.path, actions)\n
