_action(route))\n                  for router in ROUTERS for route in router.router.routes\n                  if route.path.startswith(\"/admin\")\n                  for method in route.methods)\n\n\ndef _template_for(method: str, concrete: str, templates) -> tuple[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"The route a concrete table row reaches. A literal segment beats a path\n    parameter, as it does when the app dispatches (preview before {page_id}).\"\"\"\n    matches = [(m, t) for m, t in templates if m == method\n               and re.fullmatch(re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"[^/]+\", t), concrete)]\n    return min(matches, key=lambda mt: mt[1].count(\"{\"), default=None)\n\n\ndef test_routers_seen_here_are_the_whole_console():\n    from tests.test_t09 import swept_routes\n    templates = {(m, re.sub(r\"\\{[^}]+\\}\", \"1\", re.sub(r\"\\{filename\\}\", \"x.png\", p)))\n                 for m, p, _ in console_routes()}\n    assert templates == set(swept_routes(create_app(), \"/admin\"))\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_only_or_state_changing_route_is_in_a_table():\n    routes = console_routes()\n    templates = [(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes]\n    in_editor_table = {_template_for(m, p.replace(\"{other}\", \"1\"), templates)\n                       for m, p in ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES}\n    assert None not in in_editor_table, \"an ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES row matches no route\"\n\n    admin_only = {(m, p) for m, p, a in routes\n                  if policy.ROLE_RULES.get(a) == frozenset({policy.ADMIN})}\n    must_be_listed = admin_only | {(m, p) for m, p, _ in routes\n                                   if m in STATE_CHANGING}\n    missing = sorted(must_be_listed - Issue #2 criterion 1: Account schema fields (passes)\n\nThe test reads the `account` table's columns from the database. It checks for email, name, class year, role, password hash, active and created timestamp. It also checks that:\n- email is unique,\n- the seeded password hashes start with `$argon2`,\n- `created_at` is filled in automatically, in the form `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`,\n- a role of `'owner'` is refused by the database.\n\n**One point for you to decide:** the criterion says \"schema\", so I tested the database table, where every field exists. The Python class `Account` (`app/accounts.py:17`) is missing two of the listed fields: it has no `password_hash` and no `created_at`. Leaving the hash out of that class looks deliberate and safe. If by \"Account model\" you meant that class, those two fields are missing and adding them means changing app code, so I stopped there.\n\n**Would fail if:** a listed column is dropped or renamed in `SCHEMA` (`app/db.py`), the `UNIQUE` on email is removed, the `CHECK` on role is removed, or the default on `created_at` is removed.\n\n### 2. Issue #2 criterion 8: no role checks outside the policy module (fails)\n\n**How the scan works:** it parses every `.py` file in `app/` except `app/policy.py`. It flags two things:\n- a Python comparison where one side is `x.role`, `role` or `x[\"role\"]`,\n- a SQL string with `WHERE`/`AND`/`OR`/`CHECK` followed by a test on `role`.\n\nMy first version also flagged two harmless lines: `accounts.py:87` (`SET role = ?`, which sets the role rather than testing it) and `routes/accounts.py:78` (a function call that passes `role` as an argument). I narrowed the scan to drop them. A small extra test checks that the scan still catches a planted role check.\n\n**Everything the scan finds:**\n\n| Location | Allowlisted? | Reason |\n|---|---|---|\n| `app/db.py:10` the CHECK constraint on role | yes | It only defines which roles are valid |\n| `app/accounts.py:75,77` `_is_last_active_admin` | yes | The last-active-Admin rule; it looks at the Account being changed, not the person signed in |\n| `app/accounts.py:85` `set_role` | yes | Checks whether the new role is a demotion, for the same rule |\n| `app/routes/accounts.py:74` `create_account` | yes | Checks the submitted role form field |\n| `app/routes/accounts.py:87` `change_role` | yes | Same: checks the submitted role form field |\n| `app/routes/console.py:16` `admin_home` | **no** | The dashboard decides what to show from the signed-in role |\n| `app/routes/recaps.py:89` `_editor_id` | **no** | Decides whether a save is limited to the Editor's own Draft. This one is a real permission decision |\n| `app/routes/recaps.py:112` `_save` | **no** | Decides whether the Byline is typed in or taken from the Account |\n| `app/routes/recaps.py:179` `list_recaps` | **no** | Decides whether the Owner filter is used |\n\nThe allowlist is matched by file and function, not line number. If an allowlisted function no longer contains a role check, the test fails, so the list can't go out of date quietly.\n\n**Outside the scan:** the templates are in `templates/`, not `app/`, so the scan doesn't cover them. They also compare `account.role == \"admin\"`, in `recaps.html:15`, `recap_form.html:23`, `dashboard.html:9,15` and `_header.html:5`.\n\n**Would fail if:** any new role comparison appears in `app/` outside `policy.py` and the five allowlisted functions. It fails today on the four route checks above.\n\n**I need your decision here.** The real fix is to add policy questions, for example `policy.can(account, \"recaps.see_all\")`, and change those four lines to use them. It takes each route's policy action from its `require(...)` guard and cross-checks the full list against the app's OpenAPI schema, so a new route can't be missed.\n\n**What it checks:** there are 37 `/admin` routes, and 33 of them need to be listed:\n- 25 are admin-only, meaning their action is allowed only for Admins.\n- 8 more change state but Editors may use them.\n\nEach `ADMIN_ONLY_ROUTES` row is matched to the route it actually reaches. The 28 rows cover all 25 admin-only routes, plus edit, Submit and delete on someone else's Recap.\n\n**The new Editor-allowed list** in the new file has 8 entries, each with its reason. They are Recap create, preview of a new Recap, edit, delete, Submit, preview, image upload and image delete, all on the Editor's own Draft.\n\n**No route is missing from both lists.** To make sure the test isn't empty, I ran it with one table row removed and then with one allowed entry removed. {"parentUuid":"19553300-7b7c-4077-b3e7-7742a4ed4086","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"9ccd9762-1e60-43dd-b5b0-efae360f23b6","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EfH8BzjyBbngf17Hif2BrT","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"ba098118-12a6-4add-9e3e-5971fdb8f272","timestamp":"2026-10-24T21:38:16.877Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py","oldString":"    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n","newString":"    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    # the dashboard's site-wide counts and \"changes not yet live\" notice\n    \"console.overview\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":15,"oldLines":6,"newStart":15,"newLines":8,"lines":[" # action -> roles allowed to do it"," ROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {","     \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),","+    # the dashboard's site-wide counts and \"changes not yet live\" notice","+    \"console.overview\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","     \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","     \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","     \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"19553300-7b7c-4077-b3e7-7742a4ed4086","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ac10d971-c94c-4656-a655-6f2183c6feb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    # the dashboard's site-wide counts and \"changes not yet live\" notice\n    \"console.overview\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":6,"newStart":28,"newLines":12,"lines":["     \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","     \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","     \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","+    # everyone's Recaps in lists and counts, and the Owner filter","+    \"recaps.see_all\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","+    # writes to any Recap; otherwise a write is pinned to the Account's own","+    \"recaps.edit_any\": frozenset({ADMIN}),","+    # type a Contributor Byline; otherwise it comes from the Account","+    \"recaps.type_byline\": frozenset({ADMIN}),"," }"," "," # Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9f3881ac-efd5-4a61-904f-9f1062d0eda8","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ac10d971-c94c-4656-a655-6f2183c6feb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

console pages with the test client and print every href/src.\n\n    uv run python <this> <out-file>\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient  # noqa: E402\n\nfrom app import db, settings  # noqa: E402\n\ntmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH = tmp / \"t.db\"\nsettings.UPLOADS = tmp / \"uploads\"\ndb.init_db()\n\nfrom app import seed  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.main import create_app  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_from, log_in  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.test_t03 import make_recap, make_trip  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.test_t06 import PNG  # noqa: E402\n\nseed.seed_accounts(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"], DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"password\"])\n\n\ndef client(role):\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    log_in(c, DEMO_USERS[role][\"email\"], DEMO_USERS[role][\"password\"])\n    return c\n\n\nadmin, editor = client(\"admin\"), client(\"editor\")\ntrip_id = make_trip(admin)\nrecap_id = make_recap(editor, trip_id)\ntoken = csrf_from(editor.get(f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"))\nr = editor.post(f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}/images\",\n                data={\"csrf_token\": token, \"alt\": \"A view\"},\n                files={\"file\": (\"a.png\", PNG, \"image/png\")})\nassert r.status_code in (200, 303), r.status_code\ntoken = csrf_from(admin.get(\"/admin/pages/new\"))\nadmin.post(\"/admin/pages\", data={\"csrf_token\": token, \"title\": \"About\",\n                                 \"slug\": \"about\", \"body\": \"Hi\", \"nav_position\": \"1\"})\n\nPAGES = [(admin, \"/admin\"), (admin, \"/admin/recaps\"), (admin, \"/admin/recaps/new\"),\n         (editor, f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\"), (admin, \"/admin/trips\"),\n         (admin, \"/admin/trips/new\"), (admin, f\"/admin/trips/{trip_id}\"),\n         (admin, \"/admin/pages\"), (admin, \"/admin/pages/new\"), (admin, \"/admin/pages/1\"),\n         (admin, \"/admin/accounts\"), (admin, \"/admin/accounts/new\"),\n         (editor, \"/admin/accounts\"), (editor, \"/admin\")]\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nlines = []\nfor c, path in PAGES:\n    resp = c.get(path, headers={\"accept\": \"text/html\"})\n    who = \"editor\" if c is editor else \"admin\"\n    lines.append(f\"== {who} {path} {resp.status_code}\")\n    lines += [f\"  {k}={v}\" for k, v in LINK.findall(resp.text)]\nPath(sys.argv[1]).write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\")\nprint(f\"{len(lines)} lines -> {sys.argv[1]}\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018h2HtdFfxd1gvXEfwX6APk","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd
